name: ab-data-engineering
description: Data-engineering agent brigade: the standard brigade surface — mise (readiness gate), expo (the composing coordinator that decomposes a DE request and fires the stations it needs), service (the on/off switch) — over eval-proven DE stations, each shipped only with two-arm execution-eval evidence. One station live: pipeline-failure-triage (+1.00 lift on silent zero-row failure classification). The menu carries honest per-task status for the rest of the vertical (held-for-refire, weak-evidence, base-model-covered-pending). Slated to gain a warehouse connector next, at which point mise becomes the load-bearing onboarding gate. Eval reports in evals/.
